Q6111.reason: The ordinance is content-neutral (it bans littering regardless of message) and serves an important interest, so it survives O'Brien-style scrutiny even though the dumping was expressive conduct.

Q5735.reason: A plaintiff cannot remove under 28 U.S.C. § 1441, which allows only the defendant to remove, so the federal court would remand the entire case.

Q5651.reason: An "as is" clause generally cannot negate the seller's express description of the car as a 1964 model in the advertising, so the disclaimer is not fully effective.
